summary: Barclays PLC and Barclays Bank PLC filed a Form 6-K with the London Stock Exchange announcing a board committee change. Julia Wilson assumed the role of Chair of the Barclays Bank PLC Remuneration Committee effective June 2, 2026, replacing Mary Francis who retired from the Barclays boards. Wilson had served as a committee member since July 2023. This is a routine board succession event, not a forced departure, as Francis's retirement is described without contest. No deal terms or financial details are disclosed. Watch for further committee changes as part of normal governance.
